This directory contains a minimal vendored subset derived from the upstream AnyTouch2 repository:
https://github.com/GeWu-Lab/AnyTouch2

Vendored components:
- `tactile_mae.py`
- `util/pos_embed.py`
- `CLIP-B-16/config.json`

These files are adapted only as needed for local packaging and import paths. The upstream project is
distributed under its repository license; see `TEMP_REPO/AnyTouch2-main/LICENSE` in this workspace for the
original license text and attribution context.
